description: This file defines a class MismatchedTokenException, which is a specific kind of RecognitionException used in parser error handling to signify mismatched tokens during parsing processes.

classes.name: MismatchedTokenException
classes.description: A class representing an exception thrown when a mismatched token is encountered during parsing, extending RecognitionException.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for MismatchedTokenException, initializes with expected token type and input stream.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the exception including the unexpected token type and the expected type.
